address: 2F, 112, Section 2, Zhongshan North Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: Since 1956, this restaurant has been attracting loyal fans with its authentic Yunnan fare made with produce shipped from the province – some recipes were inherited from the owner’s mother. Scaly hedgehog fried rice with shredded chicken stars a rare mushroom from Yunnan that imparts earthy aromas. Another must-try, string bean knots stuffed with minced shrimp, are painstaking to craft and deliver exceptional umami and lovely textures.
